Under what conditions could empathy increase political polarization?

Empathy can increase political polarization under several conditions. First, when individuals are exposed to information that confirms their existing beliefs and attitudes, they may empathize with those who share their views while remaining distant from those who do not. Second, if there is a lack of effective communication channels or if communication is conducted in a way that does not foster mutual understanding, empathy may not be sufficient to mitigate polarization.
